title: Geologic Map of the Chicora Quadrangle, Berkeley County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2010, Geologic Map of the Chicora Quadrangle, Berkeley County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-177, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet, mostly Lake Moultrie; map face is OCR noise. OCR misread: 'Thickness | to 40 feet' read as 1 (inferred). Map symbols for most units are garbled ('[Fen ]') and not recorded. Section A-A' read from a page-image tile of its western part: holes 8-194, 8-337, 8-338 (drawn dashed) with contact elevations read off the section's own scale (feet above sea level; inferred, about +/-1 ft); the rest of the section is under Lake Moultrie (QPph and Ladson units, no holes). Uppermost elevations (75, 95, 57 ft) recorded as unit tops with no datum printed. Dorchester Scarp, contact and drill hole symbol from the legend only. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
